title: One reflection logic for every type
quote: aip-836d should be fully generic, not only for decisions: metrics, lessons, terms and the rest all follow the same logic. The command that lists what holds is a good idea.
means: brain's reflection is one logic for every type, not only decisions and terms: every new doc of any type is checked against the docs of its type that hold and says what it supersedes or merges; what holds is computed the same way for all, and the command lists it for all.

supersedes.what: d-8725 gave the reflection to decisions and terms; it governs every type.

reflection.checked: every decision before d-0020 that held
